Unexpected behavior when setting output verbosity in VEF configuration file outside the required 0-3.

Example configuration file:

# Note: this is an automatically generated config file.
# Generic section
# ===============
VEF_mod              # Prefix for the output files
True                 # Flag: request incremental output of the material state
3                    # Verbosity level: 0 (the lowest) - 3 (the highest)


Setting verbosity to negative value let's execution freeze, setting it to value >3 falls back to (likely) verbosity level 3.

Desired behavior:
User receives error message when verbosity out of defined bounds. Or verbosity is set to minumum or maximum value and user gets notified.
